build.buildCommand: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && sed -i 's/provider = "sqlite"/provider = "postgresql"/' packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && pnpm --filter @repo/db exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter api build

deploy.preDeployCommand: sed -i 's/provider = "sqlite"/provider = "postgresql"/' packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && pnpm --filter @repo/db exec prisma db push --skip-generate
